text: Understood, and sorry for the mix-up. Original live settings are back at $1 a bet ($10 game, $20 day). The experimental curve rule now trades $0.10 per bet (min 8 contracts). One catch I found: my earlier $0.10 change did nothing, because the code forces a $1 minimum stake and 20 contracts. The new experimental 75-89% tier from #2 is still journal-only; I'll let it go real at $0.10 once the first results show it isn't a loser. Ships in the next release with #1/#3/#5.
